input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 imposes the insurance program on Vendor (Brightline) for our benefit and matches or exceeds our preferred position at every point: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate; professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (appropriate given Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data under Sections 15 and 17); and workers' compensation as required by law, plus employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 as an extra. The duration (term plus one year) tracks our model language. Section 18.2 adds the certificate-on-request obligation we require and goes further with reputable-insurer and primary-coverage requirements, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (preserving our recovery under Sections 20 and 21). No customer-side burden or coverage gap is present, so no redline is warranted.
